title: NCAA: Tulabut, Gojo Cruz star as Perpetual avoids upset against San Sebastian
summary: University of Perpetual Help avoided a stunning upset after escaping San Sebastian College, 86-74, in NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball on Monday at the PhilSports Arena in Pasig City.
